commitMessage: Fixed bug 411585: Mark occurrences reports 0 based line numbers but the actual line numbers in the line number rulers starts with 1
dslRule:
/*!
<!id: javaElementLine.getLineToGetLineNumber>
<!description: Renames `JavaElementLine.getLine()` to `JavaElementLine.getLineNumber()`.
This reflects a method rename in Eclipse JDT internal API to clarify 0-based indexing.
>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: method-rename, api-modernization>
*/
$obj.getLine() :: instanceof($obj, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.search.JavaElementLine")
=> $obj.getLineNumber()
;;
summary: Renames `JavaElementLine.getLine()` to `JavaElementLine.getLineNumber()` to reflect API change.

commitMessage: Fixed wrong action name of MultiFormatAction
dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.multiFormatActionNameFix>
<!description: Fixes MultiFormatAction to use its dedicated name constant, correcting a bug where it used a generic format action label.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.actions.ActionMessages.FormatAllAction_label :: inClass("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.actions.MultiFormatAction")
=> org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.actions.ActionMessages.MultiFormatAction_name
;;
summary: Replaces `ActionMessages.FormatAllAction_label` with `ActionMessages.MultiFormatAction_name` specifically within the `MultiFormatAction` class.
